title: The locked preset resolves to its normative parameter values
rationale: Under locked the evidence threshold has no effect, so this vector asserts nothing about it: no proposal is ever raised for a threshold to gate.

requirement.text: The five preset names — serialized in lowercase per the manifest schema — have the following normative values. locked: proposalFrequency 0, evidenceThreshold n/a, autoAcceptCeiling none, exploratory proposals not permitted.
